title: CrossRE: A Cross-Domain Dataset for Relation Extraction
findings: The paper does not present any findings related to religion. Religion is mentioned only as a potential example for one of the 17 relation types ('GENERAL-AFFILIATION') but is not analyzed or discussed in the results.
